smoke_iteration_note: The first smoke attempt failed at config parsing before producing results because SmolVLAConfig.from_pretrained received the factory type field. The script was corrected to use LeRobot's make_policy_config factory; a fresh v2 smoke output was used and passed. The first diagnostic log was preserved.

evaluation_code_provenance.quaternion_limit: HDF5 stores ee_ori axis-angle and does not retain the original robot0_eef_quat. Training collection calls robosuite transform.quat2axisangle; evaluation calls quat_xyzw_to_axis_angle, whose formula is the same axis-angle expression after explicit quaternion normalization. Exact parity for live quaternions was therefore not measured in this audit.

mapping_method: task0 LeRobot episode ids 0-4 and frame ids are verified from returned row fields; full HDF5-to-dataset action/state/pixel parity was previously completed

interpretation_limit: All 25 matched recorded observations have exact raw loader/evaluation image and stored 15-D state equality, and exact equality after the saved training preprocessor is applied to both paths (including image tensors, state, language tokens/mask, and task). The strict evaluator uses the same saved preprocessor factory. This does not compare the runtime simulator quaternion-to-axis-angle conversion against the training collector at the same live quaternion, because the source HDF5 contains no raw quaternion. It also does not run the model or test simulator-generated states outside the demonstrations.
